name: Pediculosis corporis (body lice)
advice: The lice live in clothes, not on skin — wash all clothes and bedding in hot water (≥50 °C) and dry hot, or seal them in a bag for 2 weeks. Daily bath and clean clothes cure most cases. Report fever (lice can spread trench fever / typhus).

Whole body neck down overnight, wash in morning; for persistent infestation
